description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key on the Professional or Research plan. The full published history of private funding rounds into space companies, not only the last 90 days: date, amount (null when undisclosed or stated only approximately, never estimated), series and round type, pre- and post-money valuation where the source names the basis, lead investor and every listed investor, how the round is evidenced and its source link. Filter by company, investor, stage, dates and amount; page with offset.

investor.description: Investor name: matches the lead investor or any listed investor (substring).

limit.description: How many rounds to return (1 to 25).

min_amount_usd.description: Only rounds with a disclosed amount at or above this, in US dollars.

offset.description: Rounds to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

since.description: Rounds dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

stage.description: Round stage or series label (substring), e.g. "Seed", "Series B".

until.description: Rounds dated on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: funding_round_history
title: Funding round history
